scene: 悬崖外沿站着一个人，脚下就是空处。 He stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
sceneCN: 这里 edge 是「边缘、外沿」（第 1 个义项：物体表面的最外边界）；句意为他在悬崖边站着，向下看。图中可辨识物件：悬崖外沿、空处、向下看的人。

pos.zh: 名词：边缘；刀刃；优势；尖锐；紧张

derivatives.zh: 由本词加形容词后缀构成，义为「紧张不安的；前卫的」
由本词加名词后缀构成，义为「边缘饰条」
由本词加过去分词后缀构成，义为「有刃的；镶边的」

senses.title: The outer limit of a surface
senses.definition: the line or area where a surface ends and something else begins
senses.definitionCN: 一个表面结束、另一事物开始的界线或区域
senses.example: He stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
senses.exampleCN: 他站在悬崖边，向下看。
senses.why: Old English ecg named both the border and the blade, because a blade is the very edge of a tool.
senses.whyCN: 古英语 ecg 同时指边界与刀刃，因为刀刃正是一件工具最外的那条边。

senses.title: The cutting side of a blade
senses.definition: the sharp side of a knife, axe or other cutting tool
senses.definitionCN: 刀、斧或其他切割工具上锋利的那一侧
senses.example: The axe had a chip on its edge after the storm.
senses.exampleCN: 暴风雨过后，斧刃上崩了一个口。
senses.why: The same word covers border and blade because the cutting part is the boundary of the metal itself.
senses.whyCN: 同一个词兼指边界与刀刃，因为切割的部分正是金属自身的边界。

senses.title: An advantage over others
senses.definition: a small advantage that makes one person or group likely to win
senses.definitionCN: 使某人或某群体更可能获胜的一点优势
senses.example: Years of night races gave her an edge on the track.
senses.exampleCN: 多年的夜间比赛让她在赛道上占了优势。
senses.why: To be at the edge is to be one step ahead of the rest, and a step ahead is an advantage.
senses.whyCN: 处在边缘就是比别人靠前一步，而靠前一步就是优势。

senses.title: A sharp or tense quality
senses.titleCN: 尖锐：声音或情绪的锋利感；紧张
senses.definition: a sharp, angry or nervous quality in a voice, mood or atmosphere, as in on edge
senses.definitionCN: 声音、情绪或气氛中的尖锐、恼怒或紧张，如短语 on edge
senses.example: There was an edge in his voice that worried everyone.
senses.exampleCN: 他声音里有一股尖锐，让大家都担心起来。
senses.why: A blade's edge cuts, so a mood with an edge is a mood that can cut into others.
senses.whyCN: 刀刃的 edge 会割人，所以带着 edge 的情绪就是一种会割到别人的情绪。

senses.title: To move gradually
senses.definition: to move slowly and carefully in small steps, or to move something that way
senses.definitionCN: 以小步缓慢小心地移动，或以同样方式移动某物
senses.example: She edged the chair toward the window.
senses.exampleCN: 她把椅子一点点挪向窗边。
senses.why: Moving along the edge of a thing is slow and cautious, so the verb took the sense of gradual movement.
senses.whyCN: 沿着某物的边缘移动既慢又小心，于是动词取得了「渐进移动」的意思。

intro.en: Edge is a native Old English word that named a border and a blade at once, and the advantage sense is much later.
intro.cn: edge 是古英语本族词，同时指边界与刀刃，而「优势」义出现得晚得多。

items.en: A root connected with sharpness or a cutting point is sometimes proposed, but the reconstruction is uncertain.
items.cn: 有时会提出一个与「锋利、切割点」有关的词根，但重构结果不确定。

items.en: A Germanic noun for edge or blade is reconstructed and survives in several languages.
items.cn: 一般认为存在一个表示「边缘、刀刃」的日耳曼语名词，并在多种语言中留存。

items.en: Ecg meant edge, border and sword-blade, already joining the three ideas.
items.cn: ecg 意为边缘、边界与剑刃，当时已把三种意思合在一起。

items.en: The word settled into the modern spelling and added the sense of a boundary in space or time.
items.cn: 这个词固定为现代拼写，并加入「空间或时间边界」的意思。

items.en: The advantage and nervous-tension senses came from sport and from the image of a cutting mood.
items.cn: 优势义与紧张义分别来自体育运动与「锋利情绪」的意象。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers words close in spelling; the near-meaning group gathers words for borders, blades and advantages.
note.cn: 形近组收拼写接近的词；近义组收表示边界、刀刃与优势的词。

entries.definition: An adjective meaning nervous, tense or stylistically sharp.
entries.definitionCN: 形容词，义为「紧张不安的」或「风格前卫的」。

entries.definition: A border or trim along an edge.
entries.definitionCN: 沿边缘的饰边或镶边。

entries.definition: An adverb meaning sideways, or on edge.
entries.definitionCN: 副词，义为「侧着地」或「沿边地」。

entries.definition: The line dividing two areas or countries.
entries.definitionCN: 划分两个地区或国家的界线。

entries.definition: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.
entries.definitionCN: 刀或工具上扁平的切割部分。

entries.definition: A condition that puts one in a better position.
entries.definitionCN: 使人处于更有利地位的条件。

normalIntro.en: These hooks run along a cliff edge, then along a blade, then toward advantage and tension.
normalIntro.cn: 下面这些钩子先沿悬崖边缘走，再沿刀刃走，最后走向优势与紧张。

normal.en: Edge is a line where one thing stops and another begins.
normal.cn: edge 是一条线，在那里一件事结束，另一件事开始。

normal.en: A blade is the edge of the metal, so knife and border share one word.
normal.cn: 刀刃就是金属的边，所以刀与边界共用一个词。

normal.en: One step past the edge is one step ahead of the crowd.
normal.cn: 越过边缘一步，就是领先人群一步。

normal.en: A voice with an edge can cut, just as a blade can.
normal.cn: 带 edge 的嗓音会割人，就像刀刃一样。

normal.en: To edge forward is to move as if along a cliff: small, careful steps.
normal.cn: edge forward 就是像沿悬崖那样移动：小步、小心。

abstract.en: Picture a boot toe exactly on a chalk line at the lip of a drop.
abstract.cn: 想象一只鞋尖正好停在悬崖边的一条粉笔线上。

abstract.en: The same line can be a cliff, a knife, a scoreboard or a tone of voice.
abstract.cn: 同一条线可以是悬崖、刀刃、记分牌或说话的腔调。

abstract.en: Edge means the place where position becomes decisive.
abstract.cn: edge 意味着位置变得具有决定性的那个地方。

examples.en: He stood at the edge of the cliff and looked down.
examples.cn: 他站在悬崖边，向下看。

examples.en: Years of night races gave her an edge on the track.
examples.cn: 多年的夜间比赛让她在赛道上占了优势。

examples.en: She edged the chair toward the window.
examples.cn: 她把椅子一点点挪向窗边。

sensesIntro.en: Five senses of edge: a boundary in space, the boundary of a blade, a step ahead of others, a cutting tone, and a cautious movement.
sensesIntro.cn: edge 的五个义项：空间边界、刀刃的边界、领先他人的一步、割人的腔调，以及小心的移动。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a boot toe stops exactly on a chalk line at the lip of a drop.
core.cn: 核心意象：鞋尖正好停在悬崖边的一条粉笔线上。

branches.en: THE BORDER: the line where a surface or area ends.
branches.cn: 边界线：表面或区域结束的那条线。

branches.en: THE BLADE: the sharp boundary of a cutting tool.
branches.cn: 刀刃线：切割工具锋利的边界。

branches.en: THE ADVANTAGE: being one step past the others.
branches.cn: 优势线：比别人多走一步。

branches.en: THE TENSION: a voice or mood that can cut.
branches.cn: 紧张线：会割人的嗓音或情绪。

branches.en: THE MOTION: moving as if along a cliff, in small steps.
branches.cn: 移动线：像沿悬崖那样小步移动。

intro.en: Edge is native Old English; English adds suffixes and compounds rather than Latin roots.
intro.cn: edge 是古英语本族词，英语加后缀与复合成分，而不是拉丁词根。

latinIntro.en: Latin has no part in this word; the learned synonym acies belongs to a different tradition.
latinIntro.cn: 这个词没有拉丁语成分；书面同义词 acies 属于另一传统。

items.exampleCN: 它是 edge 的直接来源。

definition_en: to try to find or get something, often with effort and over time
core_image: 一只手在黑暗中四处摸索，朝着微光前进
scene: 求职者翻遍了招聘网站，仍不放弃。 Thousands of graduates seek better jobs in big cities every year.
sceneCN: 这里 seek 是「寻找；寻求」（第 1 个义项：努力寻找想要的东西）；句意是每年数以千计的毕业生在大城市寻找更好的工作。

derivatives.zh: seek 加 -er 名词后缀，义为「寻求者；探索者」
sought 加形容词化后缀，义为「抢手的；受追捧的」

senses.title: To try to find something
senses.definition: to search for something you want or need
senses.definitionCN: 搜寻想要或需要的东西
senses.example: Dogs seek food by smell.
senses.exampleCN: 狗靠嗅觉寻找食物。
senses.why: The hand reaches into the dark, moving toward a hint of light.
senses.whyCN: 手伸进黑暗，朝一丝光亮移动。

senses.title: To try to achieve a goal
senses.definition: to attempt to reach or obtain an aim
senses.definitionCN: 努力达成或获得某个目标
senses.example: The party seeks greater freedom for students.
senses.exampleCN: 该党派谋求学生更大的自由。
senses.why: What begins as hunting a thing becomes hunting a future.
senses.whyCN: 从寻找一件东西变成追寻一个未来。

senses.title: To ask for help or permission
senses.definition: to ask someone for help, advice, or approval
senses.definitionCN: 向人请求帮助、建议或许可
senses.example: You should seek legal advice first.
senses.exampleCN: 你应先咨询法律意见。
senses.why: When the light is far away, you ask another lamp to show the way.
senses.whyCN: 当光太远时，你请另一盏灯指路。

senses.title: To try to reach a place or state
senses.definition: to head toward a place, condition, or situation
senses.definitionCN: 朝某个地方、状态或处境前进
senses.example: Refugees seek safety across the border.
senses.exampleCN: 难民越境寻求安全。
senses.why: The movement of seeking ends at a destination — the body follows the search.
senses.whyCN: 寻访的移动终于抵达处所——身体跟随搜寻前行。

senses.title: Naturally tend toward
senses.definition: to move or develop toward a condition automatically
senses.definitionCN: 自然而然地朝某种状态移动或发展
senses.example: Water seeks the lowest level.
senses.exampleCN: 水往低处流。
senses.why: Even without hands, everything quietly slides toward where it belongs.
senses.whyCN: 即使没有手，万物也悄然滑向自己的归属。

intro.en: From Old English secan, related to Latin sagire (to perceive keenly) by some scholars.
intro.cn: 来自古英语 secan，部分学者认为与拉丁语 sagire（敏锐感知）相关。

items.en: A possible root *sag- relates to tracking and perceiving.
items.cn: 可能的词根 *sag- 与追踪、感知相关。

items.en: Germanic sekon meant to seek, and gave Dutch zoeken and German suchen.
items.cn: 日耳曼 sekon 意为寻找，衍生出荷兰语 zoeken、德语 suchen。

items.en: Old English secan meant to look for, aim at, or visit.
items.cn: 古英语 secan 意为寻找、瞄准或拜访。

items.en: The strong past form sought became fixed in Middle English.
items.cn: 强变化过去式 sought 在中古英语中固定下来。

items.en: Modern seek keeps searching, pursuing, and requesting uses.
items.cn: 现代 seek 保留搜寻、追求与请求诸义。

note.en: Look-alikes near the see- spelling, and near rivals in the searching field.
note.cn: see- 拼写附近的形近词，以及搜寻义场的近义词。

entries.definition: seek ends in k; sea ends silently
entries.definitionCN: 寻找 vs 海——拼写相近，注意词尾区别

entries.definition: to look quickly and secretly
entries.definitionCN: 偷看——与 seek 拼写相近但词源不同

entries.definition: quiet and gentle
entries.definitionCN: 温顺的——形近词，词义完全不同

entries.definition: to look carefully for something
entries.definitionCN: 搜查——强调仔细翻找的过程，seek 强调目的

entries.definition: to chase or follow a goal
entries.definitionCN: 追求——与「谋求」义项近义，更书面

entries.definition: to chase animals or search hard
entries.definitionCN: 追猎；搜寻——语气更强烈，常用于追捕

normalIntro.en: Hooks on the reaching hand, the irregular past, and spelling neighbors.
normalIntro.cn: 基于伸出的手、不规则过去式与拼写邻居的记忆钩子。

normal.en: seek → sought: the k turns into a gh like think → thought
normal.cn: seek → sought：k 变成 gh，规律同 think → thought

normal.en: water seeks its own level is the famous proverb
normal.cn: 水往低处流是著名谚语，对应第五义项

normal.en: seeker is the person, sought-after is the popular thing
normal.cn: seeker 是人，sought-after 是抢手之物

normal.en: hide and seek: the game keeps the oldest sense
normal.cn: 捉迷藏这个游戏保留了最古老的意义

normal.en: seek advice is the polite way to ask
normal.cn: seek advice 是请求帮助的礼貌说法

abstract.en: Picture hands sweeping a dark attic toward a faint window
abstract.cn: 想象双手在昏暗阁楼里摸索，朝微亮的窗户靠近

abstract.en: Feel yourself leaning forward out of a moving crowd
abstract.cn: 感受自己从涌动的人群中向前倾身

abstract.en: See water quietly choosing the lowest valley
abstract.cn: 看见水悄然选择最低的山谷

examples.en: He sought shelter from the sudden storm.
examples.cn: 他找地方躲避突如其来的风暴。

examples.en: The company seeks new markets in Asia.
examples.cn: 这家公司在亚洲开拓新市场。

examples.en: You should seek a second opinion before surgery.
examples.cn: 手术前你应征求第二意见。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「细抠」——找东西要像细抠细节一样，一点点抠出来才找得到。

root: 古英语 secan「寻找、拜访」，属日耳曼强变化动词，过去式 sought 与 think→thought 同构；远源可能与表「敏锐感知」的词根相关（存疑）。

sensesIntro.en: From groping in the dark grow five directions: finding things, chasing goals, asking for lamps, arriving at shelter, and water finding its level.
sensesIntro.cn: 从黑暗中摸索长出五个方向：找物、追目标、求指引、抵庇护、水归低处。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a hand groping through darkness toward faint light
core.cn: 核心意象：黑暗中伸出的手，朝微光摸索

branches.en: the eye and the hand hunt for what is missing
branches.cn: 眼与手一起搜寻缺失之物

branches.en: the search turns into a long chase of goals
branches.cn: 搜寻变成长久的追逐

branches.en: asking someone else to hold the lamp
branches.cn: 请别人为你举灯

branches.en: the whole body moves toward refuge
branches.cn: 整个身体朝庇护所移动

branches.en: even water knows where to go without seeking hard
branches.cn: 连水都无需费力便知去向

definition_en: to move smoothly over a surface, or a smooth surface for sliding
core_image: 孩子从光滑的滑梯上滑下
scene: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。 The children slid down the slope one by one.
sceneCN: 这里 slide 是「滑动」（第 1 个义项）；句意：孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。

derivatives.zh: 滑块；滑行物
滑动的

senses.title: Move smoothly
senses.definition: to move smoothly and easily over a surface
senses.definitionCN: 在表面上平滑轻松地移动
senses.example: The children slid down the slope one by one.
senses.exampleCN: 孩子们一个接一个从斜坡上滑下来。
senses.why: This is the basic movement sense.
senses.whyCN: 这是基本的移动义项。

senses.title: A surface for sliding
senses.definition: a smooth surface or structure for sliding down
senses.definitionCN: 供人滑下的光滑表面或结构
senses.example: The park has a long slide.
senses.exampleCN: 公园里有一座长滑梯。
senses.why: The thing you slide on takes the same name.
senses.whyCN: 用来滑的物体也用同一个名称。

senses.title: A projected picture
senses.definition: a picture shown on a screen for a talk
senses.definitionCN: 讲演时投在屏幕上的图片
senses.example: The next slide shows the results.
senses.exampleCN: 下一张幻灯片显示结果。
senses.why: Images slide from one to the next in a talk.
senses.whyCN: 讲演中图像从一张滑到下一张。

definition_en: the process of choosing someone by voting, the fact of being chosen, or a formal act of choosing
core_image: 投票站门口贴着一张名单，纸角被风吹起
scene: 晚上十点投票站关门，计票机随即开始运转。 The election result came before midnight.
sceneCN: 这里 election 是「选举」（第 1 个义项：通过投票选出人的整个过程）；句意是选举结果在午夜前出来了。

pos.zh: 名词：选举；当选；（正式）选择

derivatives.zh: 由本词去掉名词后缀 -ion 得到，义为「选举」
由 elector 加 -al 构成，义为「选举的」
由 elector 加 -ate 构成，义为「全体选民」
由本词加 -eer 构成，义为「进行竞选活动」

senses.title: The process of voting someone in
senses.definition: the organized process in which people vote to choose someone for an office
senses.definitionCN: 人们投票为某个职位选出人选的整套组织过程
senses.example: The election result came before midnight.
senses.exampleCN: 选举结果在午夜前出来了。
senses.why: Election is the noun of eligere, to pick out: the whole machinery exists for one act of picking.
senses.whyCN: election 是 eligere（挑出）的名词：整套机器只为一次「挑出」而存在。

senses.title: The fact of being chosen
senses.definition: the state or event of being chosen for a post, seen from the winner's side
senses.definitionCN: 从当选者角度看，被选上某个职位这一事实
senses.example: Her election to the board surprised no one.
senses.exampleCN: 她当选董事，没人感到意外。
senses.why: The same picking seen from inside the winner becomes a personal event rather than a public process.
senses.whyCN: 同一次挑选若从当选者内部看，就成了个人事件，而不是公共过程。

senses.title: A formal act of choosing
senses.definition: a deliberate choice between options, used in formal or religious language
senses.definitionCN: 在选项之间作出的慎重选择，用于正式或宗教语境
senses.example: He made a deliberate election to stay silent.
senses.exampleCN: 他有意选择了保持沉默。
senses.why: Before it meant voting, the word simply named a choice; that older sense survives in formal prose.
senses.whyCN: 在表示「投票」之前，这个词只指一次选择；这个更古老的意思仍活在正式文章里。

intro.en: Election comes from Latin electio, the noun of eligere, to pick out, formed from e- out and legere, to choose.
intro.cn: election 来自拉丁语 electio，即 eligere（挑出）的名词，由 e-（出）与 legere（挑选）构成。

items.en: Legere meant to gather or pick, and it also gave lecture and legend.
items.cn: legere 意为「收集、挑选」，也生出 lecture 与 legend。

items.en: E- out plus legere formed the verb to pick out from among others.
items.cn: e-（出）加 legere 构成「从众人中挑出」的动词。

items.en: Electio named the act of picking out, at first any choice at all.
items.cn: electio 指「挑出」的动作，最初泛指任何选择。

items.en: French narrowed the noun toward choosing a person for an office.
items.cn: 法语把这个名词窄化为「为职位选人」。

items.en: English used it for both the choice and the gathering that makes it.
items.cn: 英语既用它指选择本身，也指做出选择的那场集会。

items.en: The voting sense dominates, while the plain sense of choice survives in formal style.
items.cn: 投票义占了主导，而朴素的「选择」义仍留在正式文体中。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the elect family; the near-meaning group separates vote, ballot and referendum.
note.cn: 形近组收 elect 词族；近义组区分 vote、ballot 与 referendum。

definition_en: a systematic explanation of facts, a body of ideas about a subject, the principles behind a practice, or an unproven speculation
core_image: 一群人坐在看台上远远观看一场演出：先看见，再试图解释。
scene: 讲座散场，学生们还在争论黑板上的假说。 In theory, the bridge should hold twice its own weight.
sceneCN: 这里 theory 是「理论上、按推算」（第 6 个义项：抽象推算而非实际）；句意：理论上，这座桥应能承受自身重量的两倍。场景要点：图纸上的受力箭头、计算器、尚未建成的桥。

senses.title: A systematic scientific explanation
senses.titleCN: 科学理论：能解释事实的体系
senses.definition: a well-tested and widely accepted explanation of natural phenomena, supported by evidence
senses.definitionCN: 经充分检验、被广泛接受且有证据支持的自然现象解释
senses.example: The theory of plate tectonics explains why continents move.
senses.exampleCN: 板块构造理论解释了大陆为何移动。
senses.why: Greek theōria was a viewing, a act of watching. A scientific theory begins with careful observation, then builds the explanation that the watching supports.
senses.whyCN: 希腊语 theōria 是“观看、观察”。科学理论从仔细观看开始，再建立观看所支持的说明。

senses.title: A body of ideas or doctrine
senses.titleCN: 学说：一个学派的一整套看法
senses.definition: a organized set of ideas or beliefs about a subject, often associated with a school or thinker
senses.definitionCN: 关于某一主题的有组织的一套观念或信念，常与某个学派或思想家相关
senses.example: He studied Marx's theory of history for his dissertation.
senses.exampleCN: 他为博士论文研究了马克思的历史学说。
senses.why: A single observation grows into a connected body of claims. The word then names the whole doctrine, not one explanation of one fact.
senses.whyCN: 单次观察长成一套相互关联的主张。这个词于是指整套学说，而不是对单一事实的解释。

senses.title: The principles behind a practice
senses.titleCN: 原理：一门技艺背后的道理
senses.definition: the general principles or rules underlying a practical art or skill
senses.definitionCN: 某一实践技艺背后的一般原理或规则
senses.example: She studied the theory of music before touching the piano.
senses.exampleCN: 她在碰钢琴之前先学了乐理。
senses.why: Watching a practice from above yields its rules. Theory here is the map of a craft, separated from the hand that performs it.
senses.whyCN: 从高处观看一门实践，就得到它的规则。这里的 theory 是一门手艺的地图，与实际操作的双手分离。

senses.title: A hypothesis offered as explanation
senses.definition: a proposed explanation that has not yet been proven or fully tested
senses.definitionCN: 尚未被证实或充分检验的提议性解释
senses.example: His theory is that the ship sank in a sudden storm.
senses.exampleCN: 他的假设是那艘船在突发的风暴中沉没。
senses.why: The same explanatory frame can be built before the evidence arrives. Then it is a hypothesis, but English still calls it a theory.
senses.whyCN: 同样的解释框架可以在证据到来之前先搭起来。这时它是假设，但英语仍称之为 theory。

senses.title: A speculative opinion
senses.definition: an opinion or conjecture based on limited evidence, often in everyday talk
senses.definitionCN: 基于有限证据的看法或猜想，常用于日常谈话
senses.example: My theory is that the cat knocked the vase off the shelf.
senses.exampleCN: 我的推测是猫把花瓶从架子上碰了下来。
senses.why: In ordinary speech, watching becomes guessing. The word loses its scientific weight and names any attempt to explain what happened.
senses.whyCN: 在日常口语里，观看变成了猜测。这个词失去科学分量，可以指任何对事情经过的解释尝试。

senses.title: In theory: as reasoned, not as practised
senses.titleCN: 理论上：推算成立，现实未必
senses.definition: used in the phrase in theory to mean according to reasoning or principle, as opposed to actual practice
senses.definitionCN: 用于 in theory，表示按推理或原理应当如此，与实际做法相对
senses.example: In theory, the system can process a million requests a second.
senses.exampleCN: 理论上，这个系统每秒能处理一百万次请求。
senses.why: Theory is what the spectator sees from the stand; practice is what happens on the field. The phrase sets the two viewpoints against each other.
senses.whyCN: theory 是看台上观众看到的，practice 是球场上实际发生的。这个短语把两个视角摆在对立面。

senses.title: Book learning as opposed to practice
senses.titleCN: 理论课：书本上的那一半
senses.definition: the part of a subject taught as principles and books rather than as hands-on practice
senses.definitionCN: 以原理和书本而非动手实践来教授的那部分内容
senses.example: The course balances theory with six hours of lab work.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课把理论课与六小时实验课相平衡。
senses.why: In training, the viewing half and the doing half are separated. Theory class is where you watch and read before you are allowed to act.
senses.whyCN: 在培训中，“观看”的一半和“动手”的一半被分开。理论课就是你被允许动手之前观看与阅读的地方。

senses.title: Idle or unrealistic speculation
senses.definition: speculation that is impractical or disconnected from reality, often used with a critical tone
senses.definitionCN: 不切实际或脱离现实的推测，常带批评语气
senses.example: That is pure theory; no one has tried it on a real farm.
senses.exampleCN: 那纯粹是纸上谈兵；没人在真实农场里试过。
senses.why: When the stand is too far from the field, watching never turns into doing. The word then carries the old complaint against pure contemplation.
senses.whyCN: 当看台离球场太远，观看就永远变不成行动。这个词于是带上了对纯粹空想的古老抱怨。

intro.en: Theory comes from Greek theōria 'a looking at, contemplation', built on thea 'a view' and the spectator word theōros. Latin and French carried it to English, where it shifted from watching to explaining.
intro.cn: theory 来自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与“观看者”theōros 构成。经拉丁语与法语进入英语，语义从“观看”转向“解释”。

items.en: Thea meant a view or a sight, the thing seen. It survives in English words such as theatre, where the view is what the audience comes for.
items.cn: thea 意为景象、所见之物。它保留在 theatre 等英语词中——观众来剧院，正是为了那个“景象”。

items.en: Theōros was a spectator, and also an envoy sent to consult an oracle or to watch a sacred festival. Watching was a public and often official act.
items.cn: theōros 是观看者，也是被派去求神谕或观看宗教节庆的使者。观看是一种公共的、常常带官方性质的行动。

items.en: Theōria meant a looking at, contemplation, and later a body of speculative knowledge. Philosophy used it for the highest kind of seeing.
items.cn: theōria 意为观看、沉思，后来指思辨性的知识体系。哲学用它表示最高层次的“看”。

items.en: Latin borrowed theoria mainly in learned and theological writing. The word stayed close to contemplation rather than to practical skill.
items.cn: 拉丁语主要在学术与神学写作中借用 theoria。这个词始终贴近“沉思”，而不是实用技能。

items.en: French théorie reached English in the 16c. with the sense of a scheme of ideas, especially in mathematics and philosophy.
items.cn: 法语 théorie 于 16 世纪进入英语，义为观念体系，尤用于数学与哲学。

items.en: The scientific revolution fixed the modern sense: a tested explanation of evidence. The everyday sense of a guess is older and never disappeared.
items.cn: 科学革命固定了现代义：对证据的受检验解释。日常“猜测”义更古老，并且从未消失。

note.en: The first group is theory's own family; the second ranks explanation words by how much evidence they claim.
note.cn: 第一组是 theory 自身的词族；第二组按“声称有多少证据”排列各种“解释”词。

entries.definition: concerned with ideas and principles rather than practice. It describes the mode, not the claim.
entries.definitionCN: 关乎观念与原理而非实践的。它描述方式，而不是主张。

entries.definition: a person who develops or studies theories.
entries.definitionCN: 建立或研究理论的人；理论家。

entries.definition: to form theories or speculate about something.
entries.definitionCN: 建立理论；对某事进行推测。

entries.definition: a statement proven from axioms, not a general explanation. It shares the Greek root but is a different kind of claim.
entries.definitionCN: 由公理证明的命题，不是一般性解释。它共享希腊词根，但主张的类型不同。

entries.definition: a proposed explanation to be tested. It is explicitly provisional, where theory may be either tested or loose.
entries.definitionCN: 有待检验的提议性解释。它明确是暂定的，而 theory 可能是已验证的，也可能松散。

entries.definition: a body of beliefs taught by a church, party, or school. It stresses authority rather than evidence.
entries.definitionCN: 教会、政党或学派所传授的信念体系。它强调权威，而非证据。

entries.definition: a basic rule or truth that explains how something works. It is usually narrower than a theory.
entries.definitionCN: 解释某物如何运作的基本规则或真理。它通常比 theory 窄。

entries.definition: guessing about something without firm evidence. It matches the everyday and critical senses of theory.
entries.definitionCN: 在没有确凿证据的情况下猜测。它对应 theory 的日常义与批评义。

entries.definition: an opinion formed from incomplete information. It is formal and openly admits the lack of proof.
entries.definitionCN: 根据不完整信息形成的看法。它较正式，并公开承认缺乏证据。

normalIntro.en: Real parts only: Greek thea 'view' and theōros 'spectator' give theōria 'a looking at'. Family words theory, theoretical, theorist, theorize, theorem.
normalIntro.cn: 只用真实成分：希腊语 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成 theōria“观看”。词族为 theory、theoretical、theorist、theorize、theorem。

normal.en: The theatre and theory share thea: both are about a view.
normal.cn: theatre 与 theory 共享 thea：两者都与“看”有关。

normal.en: A theorist is a spectator who writes down what the game explains.
normal.cn: 理论家就是一位把比赛所说明的东西写下来的观众。

normal.en: In theory is the view from the stand; in practice is the play on the field.
normal.cn: in theory 是看台上的视角；in practice 是球场上的踢法。

normal.en: A theorem is proved; a theory is supported. Different strength of claim.
normal.cn: theorem 是被证明的；theory 是被支持的。主张的强度不同。

normal.en: My theory about the vase is just watching turned into guessing.
normal.cn: 我对花瓶事件的 theory，只是把“看见”变成了“猜测”。

abstract.en: Theory is the distance we put between seeing and acting, in order to see better.
abstract.cn: 理论，是我们在“看见”与“行动”之间拉开的距离，为了看得更清楚。

abstract.en: A theory that cannot be wrong is not a theory but a belief.
abstract.cn: 不可能出错的理论不是理论，而是信念。

abstract.en: Every practice is watched by some theory, even when the practitioner denies it.
abstract.cn: 每种实践都被某种理论注视着，即使实践者否认这一点。

examples.en: Darwin's theory took decades to be accepted by biologists.
examples.cn: 达尔文的理论花了几十年才被生物学家接受。

examples.en: The theory of harmony is easier to learn with a keyboard nearby.
examples.cn: 手边有键盘时，和声学理论更容易学。

examples.en: In theory the vaccine is free, but clinics still charge an admin fee.
examples.cn: 理论上疫苗是免费的，但诊所仍收取管理费。

dict_mnemonic.text: “思理论”——坐在看台上边看边思，慢慢就成了理论 → theory 理论、学说

root: 源自希腊语 theōria“观看、沉思”，由 thea“景象”与 theōros“观看者”构成；核心是“先看，再解释”。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses of theory, all one act of watching: from the spectator's view grows a tested explanation, a doctrine, a set of principles, a guess, a classroom subject, or empty speculation.
sensesIntro.cn: theory 的八个义项都源自同一个“观看”动作：从观看者的视角生长出受检验的解释、学说、原理、猜测、课堂科目，或空洞的思辨。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: spectators in a stand, watching a game and trying to explain it.
core.cn: 核心意象：看台上的观众，看着一场比赛并试图解释它。

branches.en: EXPLANATION: the same frame is a tested theory when the evidence is in, and a hypothesis when it is not.
branches.cn: 解释：同一框架在证据齐备时是受检验的理论，证据未到时是假设。

branches.en: DOCTRINE: a named school turns one explanation into a whole body of teaching.
branches.cn: 学说：一个有名字的学派把单一解释变成整套教导。

branches.en: PRINCIPLES: the rules behind a craft, whether written in a book or taught in a theory class.
branches.cn: 原理：一门技艺背后的规则，无论写在书里还是在理论课上讲授。

branches.en: SPECULATION: everyday guessing and idle theorizing are watching that never reaches the field.
branches.cn: 推测：日常猜测与空洞空论，都是从未落到球场上的观看。

branches.en: IN THEORY: the stand's viewpoint set explicitly against the field's practice.
branches.cn: 理论上：把看台的视角明确摆到球场的实践对面。

intro.en: Theory's family is built on the Greek root for viewing. English adds -etical, -ist, -ize, and -em, while theorem keeps a distinct mathematical path.
intro.cn: theory 的词族建立在希腊语“观看”词根上。英语加 -etical、-ist、-ize、-em；theorem 则走出一条不同的数学路径。

latinIntro.en: The Latin forms are theoria 'contemplation', theorema 'a thing looked at, a theorem', and the Late Latin adjective theoricus.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁形式是 theoria“沉思”、theorema“被观看之物、定理”，以及晚期拉丁形容词 theoricus。

items.meaning: based on ideas and principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 基于观念与原理而非实践的（-etical 构成形容词）
items.example: The paper is purely theoretical and offers no data.
items.exampleCN: 这篇论文纯属理论，没有提供数据。

items.meaningCN: 理论上；按原理（-ly 构成副词）
items.example: Theoretically, the reaction should finish in an hour.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这个反应应在一小时内完成。

items.meaning: a person who develops or studies theories
items.example: Literary theorists disagree about the author's intention.
items.exampleCN: 文学理论家对作者意图的看法不一。

items.meaningCN: 建立理论；推测（-ize 构成动词）
items.example: They theorized about the cause of the collapse.
items.exampleCN: 他们对坍塌的原因进行了理论推测。

items.meaningCN: 理论化；建立理论的过程（-ation 构成动作名词）
items.example: The book mixes fieldwork with heavy theorization.
items.exampleCN: 这本书把田野调查与大量理论化混在一起。

items.meaningCN: 由公理证明的命题；定理
items.example: The theorem holds for every prime greater than two.
items.exampleCN: 该定理对每个大于二的素数都成立。

items.meaning: according to principle, not necessarily in fact
items.meaningCN: 理论上；按理说（未必符合事实）
items.example: In theory, the two systems can run together.
items.exampleCN: 理论上，这两个系统可以同时运行。

items.meaning: the explanation of species change by natural selection
items.meaningCN: 进化论；以自然选择解释物种变化的理论
items.example: The theory of evolution rests on fossil and genetic evidence.
items.exampleCN: 进化论建立在化石与遗传学证据之上。

items.meaning: a lesson teaching principles rather than practice
items.meaningCN: 理论课；讲授原理而非实践的课程
items.example: Theory class meets on Monday; the lab is on Wednesday.
items.exampleCN: 理论课在周一，实验课在周三。

items.meaning: an explanation that claims a secret plot by powerful groups
items.meaningCN: 阴谋论；声称有权势集团秘密策划的解释
items.example: The rumour grew into a full conspiracy theory.
items.exampleCN: 这个传言发展成了完整的阴谋论。

latinEntries.structure: Latin noun borrowed from Greek theōria

latinEntries.meaning: a thing looked at, a proposition, a theorem

latinEntries.structure: Late Latin adjective from Greek theōrikos

definition_zh: 公主；王妃；亲王夫人；（口语）娇小姐
definition_en: the daughter of a king or queen, the wife of a prince, or a girl who expects to be treated like royalty
core_image: 长裙拖过石阶，女孩抬手扶住微微晃动的冠冕
scene: 舞会开始前，侍女替她理好裙摆，镜子里的女孩紧张得咬住了嘴唇。 The princess stepped onto the balcony and the crowd below fell silent.
sceneCN: 这里 princess 是「公主」（第 1 个义项：君主之女）；句意为公主走上露台，下面的众人立刻安静下来。图中可辨识物件：裙摆、镜子、露台栏杆。

pos.zh: 公主；王妃；亲王夫人；（口语）娇小姐

collocations.zh: 王储妃；女性王位继承人
长公主（英国君主授予长女的称号）

derivatives.zh: 由 princess 加 -like 构成，义为「像公主一样的」
与 princess 同出 prince 一族，加 -ly 后义为「王子的；如王子般慷慨的」

senses.title: The daughter of a monarch
senses.definition: a girl or woman who is the daughter of a king or queen
senses.definitionCN: 国王或女王的女儿
senses.example: The princess learned to ride before she could read.
senses.exampleCN: 这位公主还没学会读书就先学会了骑马。
senses.why: Old French added the feminine ending to prince, so the word began as the female counterpart and settled on the monarch's daughter.
senses.whyCN: 古法语在 prince 后加上阴性词尾，这个词一开始就是 prince 的女性对应形式，后来固定指君主的女儿。

senses.title: The wife of a prince
senses.definition: the wife of a prince, or a woman who holds the title in her own right
senses.definitionCN: 王子的妻子，或以自身权利持有这一称号的女性
senses.example: The princess accompanied her husband to the ceremony.
senses.exampleCN: 王妃陪同丈夫出席了典礼。
senses.why: The feminine ending marked the woman attached to a titled man as well as a daughter, so marriage could also bring the title.
senses.whyCN: 阴性词尾既标记「有头衔者的女儿」，也标记「与他相配的女性」，所以婚姻同样能带来这个称号。

senses.title: A spoiled, demanding girl
senses.definition: a girl or woman who expects to be waited on as if she were royal and complains easily
senses.definitionCN: 期望被当作王室成员般伺候、动辄抱怨的女孩或女性
senses.example: Stop acting like a princess and help with the dishes.
senses.exampleCN: 别摆小姐架子了，来帮忙洗碗。
senses.why: A princess in stories is served by everyone, so the title became a mocking label for someone who demands the same without earning it.
senses.whyCN: 故事里的公主事事有人伺候，于是这个称号变成一种带嘲讽的叫法，指并未付出却要求同样待遇的人。

intro.en: Princess is the feminine of prince, made in Old French with a suffix borrowed from Greek, and it has kept both the honour and the mockery of a royal title.
intro.cn: princess 是 prince 的阴性形式，在古法语中用借自希腊语的词尾构成，至今同时保留着王室称号的尊崇与调侃两面。

items.en: Princeps, the compound of first and take, was the base that Old French turned into prince.
items.cn: 由「第一」与「取」合成的 princeps，是古法语造出 prince 的基础。

items.en: Late Latin used the feminine ending -issa, generally thought to come from Greek, for the wife or daughter of a title holder, as in abbatissa.
items.cn: 一般认为，晚期拉丁语用阴性词尾 -issa 表示有头衔者的妻子或女儿，这个词尾借自希腊语，例如 abbatissa（女修道院长）。

items.en: Old French formed princesse as the feminine of prince and used it for a prince's wife or daughter.
items.cn: 古法语造出 prince 的阴性形式 princesse，用来指亲王的妻子或女儿。

items.en: English borrowed princesse in the fourteenth century, spelled it in several ways, and kept it for women of royal rank.
items.cn: 英语在十四世纪借入 princesse，其间拼法不一，始终用来指王室女性成员。

items.en: Modern English puts the title before a name and, informally, uses it to tease a girl who expects to be served.
items.cn: 现代英语把这个称号放在名字之前，也在口语里用它打趣那些要求别人伺候的女孩。

note.en: The look-alike group gathers the prince family and its feminine forms; the near-meaning group gathers female royal and noble titles.
note.cn: 形近组收 prince 词族及其阴性形式；近义组收女性王室与贵族称号。

entries.definition: The male counterpart, the son of a monarch or the ruler of a small state.
entries.definitionCN: 男性对应称号：君主之子或小国之主。

entries.definition: Belonging to a prince, or generous in the manner of one.
entries.definitionCN: 属于王子的；像王子般慷慨的。

entries.definition: A small state ruled by a prince.
entries.definitionCN: 由亲王统治的小国；公国。

entries.definition: A female monarch, or the wife of a king.
entries.definitionCN: 女君主，或国王的妻子。

entries.definition: The wife or widow of a duke, or a woman holding that rank.
entries.definitionCN: 公爵的妻子或遗孀，也指持有该爵位的女性。

entries.definition: A polite title for a woman of high rank.
entries.definitionCN: 对地位高的女性的尊称。

entries.definition: A king, queen or other single ruler of a state.
entries.definitionCN: 国王、女王等一国之君。

normalIntro.en: The word is the prince family plus a feminine ending, and that ending is the whole difference between the two titles.
normalIntro.cn: 这个词就是 prince 词族加一个阴性词尾，这个结尾正是两个称号之间的全部差别。

normal.en: Prince plus the feminine -ess gives princess, exactly as actor plus -ess gave actress.
normal.cn: prince 加阴性词尾 -ess 得到 princess，正如 actor 加 -ess 得到 actress。

normal.en: Old French wrote it princesse, which is why the ending looks longer than a plain -ess.
normal.cn: 古法语写作 princesse，所以词尾看起来比单纯的 -ess 更长。

normal.en: A crown princess is either the heir to a throne or the wife of a crown prince, so context decides.
normal.cn: crown princess 既可指王位继承人，也可指王储的妻子，要看上下文。

normal.en: Princess Royal is a title a British monarch gives to his or her eldest daughter.
normal.cn: Princess Royal 是英国君主授予长女的称号。

normal.en: The mocking sense grows from fairy tales, where a princess never clears the table herself.
normal.cn: 那个嘲讽义从童话里长出来：故事里的公主从不自己收拾桌子。

abstract.en: The word is a title pinned on a woman by birth, by marriage, or by the way she expects to be treated.
abstract.cn: 这个词是贴在女性身上的称号，来由可以是出生、婚姻，也可以是她的行事做派。

abstract.en: Every sense keeps the idea of being waited on, which is why the same word can honour and tease.
abstract.cn: 每个义项都保留着「有人伺候」的意味，所以同一个词既能表示尊崇，也能用来打趣。

abstract.en: A suffix rather than a new root made the feminine form, so the core meaning of prince still sits inside it.
abstract.cn: 女性形式靠词尾而非新词根造出，所以 prince 的核心含义仍留在里面。

examples.en: The princess opened the new school in the village.
examples.cn: 公主为村里新落成的学校剪彩。

examples.en: She became a princess when she married the king's son.
examples.cn: 她嫁给国王的儿子后成了王妃。

examples.en: Do not be such a princess about the weather.
examples.cn: 别为天气这点事就摆小姐脾气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「普林塞斯」——在「普林斯」后面添上「塞斯」，像给王子加上女字旁，就成了公主。

root: 古法语 princesse，是 prince 的阴性形式，词尾 -esse 源自晚期拉丁语 -issa（一般认为借自希腊语）；核心仍是 prince 那一族，只是换成了女性。

sensesIntro.en: The core sense is the female holder of a princely title; the senses spread from the monarch's daughter to a prince's wife and to a mocking label for a demanding girl.
sensesIntro.cn: 核心义是持有亲王称号的女性；义项从君主的女儿分到王子的妻子，再分到指娇纵女孩的调侃说法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a long skirt sweeping the stone steps as a girl steadies a small crown.
core.cn: 核心意象：长裙扫过石阶，女孩伸手扶稳一顶小冠冕。

branches.en: a girl learning to ride beside her father's guard
branches.cn: 女孩在父亲的卫队旁学骑马

branches.en: a young royal waving from a balcony
branches.cn: 年轻的王室成员在露台上挥手

branches.en: a wedding that brings a new title
branches.cn: 一场带来新头衔的婚礼

branches.en: a couple walking into the ceremony together
branches.cn: 夫妇一同走进典礼

branches.en: a girl refusing to clear the table
branches.cn: 女孩拒绝收拾桌子

intro.en: A princely base plus a feminine ending, with the ending doing all the work of turning a male title into a female one.
intro.cn: 亲王的词干加一个阴性词尾，全部的变化都由这个词尾完成，把男性称号变成女性称号。

latinIntro.en: The base is Latin princeps; the feminine ending -issa entered late Latin from Greek and reached English through Old French -esse.
latinIntro.cn: 词干是拉丁语 princeps；阴性词尾 -issa 由希腊语进入晚期拉丁语，再经古法语 -esse 传到英语。

items.meaningCN: 阴性后缀：持有称号的女性
